evidence_chain.admission: Original ledger retains one exact checkpoint with no flight or failure. Worker has one unrelated declared reservation. Existing base file bytes remain unchanged and close keeps the original Notebook.
evidence_chain.worker_ack: Releasing and acknowledging that reservation invokes the original automatic pump. The same snapshot moves into flight exactly once and charges 64990 bytes before atomic write.
evidence_chain.pending_confirmed: After actual write and owner confirmation, ledger and worker charges reach zero, pending file equals original Android worker bytes, and original pending owner retires.
evidence_chain.canonical_reopen: New Apple Model reads that file, commits one four-point stroke at revision two, and confirms canonical bytes equal to Android.

scope: An isolated original iOS App model, ledger and worker. A test-only logical charge produces temporary one-byte backpressure. The real worker and IO confirm original pending and canonical files. A new Model in the same process reopens. Physical heap, permanent oversize policy, power loss, native release and full C1 remain separate.
